about: Shared intake vectors (ROADMAP S1, ADR-0038). Rust (crates/onyx-intake/tests/vectors.rs) and the website (apps/web/tests/s1.mjs) both run every case; change only with the spec (docs/spec/submissions.md). Expectations are written by hand, not computed.

reasons.keyed_source: It needs your own API key. Your key stays in your browser. A real prover (ROADMAP S2) would make the request from your side and send Onyx only a proof of the response; the stub in this build makes no request. A keyed source is held for a rights review of its terms and never published until cleared.
reasons.proof_not_real: The proof step is not built yet (ROADMAP S2). Today the page makes no request and sends a placeholder labelled not real; it proves nothing.
reasons.source_blocked: Onyx's rights review blocks this source: its terms restrict redistribution. It is held and will not be published.
reasons.names_person: Onyx never publishes data about a person. Data may name companies, funds and protocols only.
reasons.terms_forbid: The source's terms forbid redistribution, so Onyx cannot take it.
reasons.rights_review: The rights are not known yet. It is held for a rights review and never published until a reviewer clears it.
reasons.chain_recipe: Chain data can be recomputed by anyone. It needs a recipe: a small open program that reads pinned blocks. Your submission becomes a recipe request.
reasons.public_auto_pull: Anyone can fetch it with no login, so it can reach level 2 once a reviewer clears its source's rights: bonded observers would then re-read it at the same time and must agree (built for the U.S. Treasury source after approval; other sources need their own adapter, ROADMAP S4).
reasons.live_window: It changes continuously, so observers must read it inside one short window and agree within a tolerance.
reasons.needs_login: It needs a login, key or payment, so observers cannot re-read it. It stays a claim until a way to prove the response exists (ROADMAP S2).
reasons.signed_key: The source signs it. Once the source registers its signing key, anyone can check each value's signature.
reasons.own_claim: It is your own or private data. Onyx records what you say it means as a claim.
reasons.unverified: Labelled unverified: nobody has checked it. Buyers see it as level 4.
reasons.forecast_track: A forecast cannot be checked today. It is scored later against the real answer, and your track record builds up.

noFetch.no_endpoint: No endpoint was given, so there is nothing to pull.
noFetch.not_while_refused_or_held: Nothing is pulled for a refused or held submission.
noFetch.not_auto_pull: Only public data anyone can fetch without a login is pulled.
noFetch.host_not_cleared: Onyx pulls only from sources whose rights it has already reviewed. A reviewer reads this source's terms first; nothing is fetched until then.
noFetch.port_not_allowed: Only the standard https port (443) is pulled.
